newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP RESULTS.

text.p: Results of Currie Cup rugby
union matches on Saturday:
In Welkom (played Friday): Northern Free State beat Eastern
Transvaal 33-14 (halftime 23-8).
Scorers:
Northern Free State - Tries: Pieta Steenkamp, Len van Reit,
Barnie Britz. Conversions: Eric Herbert (3). Penalties: Herbert
(3). Drop goal: Herbert
Eastern Transvaal - Try: I.P van der Merwe. Penalties: Jaco
Viljoen (2). Drop goal: Viljoen.
In Durban: Natal beat Boland 53-13 (halftime 26-6).
Scorers:
Natal - Tries: Henry Honiball (4), Cabous van der
Westhuizen, Adrian Garvey, Robert du Preez. Conversions:
Honiball (6). Penalties: Honiball (2).
Boland - Try: Stefan Terblanche. Conversion: Francois Horn.
Penalties: Horn (2).
In Kimberley: Griqualand West drew with Free State 28-28
(halftime 12-14).
Scorers:
Griqualand West - Penalty try. Conversion: Franco Smith.
Penalties: Franco Smith (7).
Free State - Tries: Andre Venter, Werner Swanepoel.
Penalties: MJ Smith (6).
In Witbank: South Eastern Transvaal beat Western Transvaal
23-21 (halftime 8-9).
Scorers:
South-Eastern Transvaal - Tries: Johan Visagie, Tobie
Oosthuizen, Hakkies Swart. Conversion: Clive Terblanche.
Penalty: Terblanche. Drop goal: Dan van Zyl.
Western Transvaal - Tries: Charl Bensch, Ricardo Erasmus.
Conversion: Dewald Basson. Penalties: Basson (3).
In Mossel Bay: Western Province beat South Western Districts
Scorers:
South Western Districts: Try: John van Standen, Herman
Freiboth. Conversion: Jurie Coetzee (2). Penalties: Coetzee (3).
Western Province: Tries: Nico Wegner (2), Joggie Viljoen
(3), Louis Koen (2), Breyton Paulse (3), Pieter Roussouw (2),
Garry Pagel, Robbie Brink (2), Fritz van Heerden, Justin Swart.
Conversions: Koen (11).
In Port Elizabeth: Eastern Province beat Border 16-13
(halftime 13-8).
Scorers:
Eastern Province - Tries: Bertus Kruger, Andre Vos.
Penalties: Kruger (2).
Border - Tries: Bennie Jacobs, Ruhan van Zyl. Penalty: Greg
Miller.
